hooks.name: Generate Test for New Component
hooks.description: When a new component file is created, generate a skeleton test for it.

action.prompt: A new React component file was just created in src/components/. Please generate a basic Vitest + React Testing Library test file for it. Place it alongside the component with the suffix `.test.tsx`. The test should: import the component, render it with a minimal store provider if needed, and assert that the main landmark element renders without crashing. Keep it small — one describe block, one or two it() cases.
